# Foul weather location

Used in [Special rules](/rules/90-special).

## Table

| Die | Sections | Delta sandstorm is normal |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | A, B | no |
| 2 | C, D | no |
| 3 | D, E | yes |
| 4 | B, C | no |
| 5 | B, D | no |
| 6 | B, C, D | no |

## Notes

- Rolled once (one die) after a sandstorm or rainstorm result on the Weather Table (29.61 / tables/weather.json); the storm covers the listed map sheets and every other sheet has normal weather
- Chart notes carried into the rules prose: a sandstorm on a Nile Delta hex is normal weather (the asterisk on the die-3 row), and sandstorms never extend north of the coastal hexes
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 102) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p8): 0 of 6 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
